newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $103/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $103/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady on a dressed basis, no sales live, USDA said.

Buyer interest mixed, seller interest limited. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights) Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 102.00, few 102.50-103.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 101.50-102.00.
